updates.tweet_text: @tradingauthori1 April was much deeper of a downtrend channel (and remember in ES, the more red, the more bullish). We are in a broader megaphone here that is shallower but a trip to megaphone resistance in the coming many months to fill out would make sense
updates.notes: Pure macro commentary on trend channels and megaphone pattern; no specific actionable price named or labeled as a level.
